cleaning_pipeline.description: Stripped surrounding double quotes from all column headers and string field values across all 45,211 records.
Scanned entire dataset for duplicate records. Exactly 0 duplicate rows were detected.
Standardized all categorical text features to trimmed lowercase representations (e.g., job, marital, education, default, housing, loan, contact, month, poutcome, y).

Documented and audited 'unknown' values across features. In the UCI bank marketing benchmark, 'unknown' is an authentic observational category representing unrecorded outreach channels (contact: 13,020 rows / 28.8%) or absence of prior contact history (poutcome: 36,959 rows / 81.75%), as well as undisclosed client demographics (education: 1,857 rows / 4.11%, job: 288 rows / 0.64%). Instead of imputing synthetic values that distort genuine historical signals, 'unknown' is preserved as a distinct categorical state encoded via OneHotEncoder.

Stages 04_Train_Data/train.csv (36,168 rows) and 05_Test_Data/test.csv (9,043 rows) represent the canonical 80/20 stratified partition with random_state=42. The BankerEye training pipeline utilizes this exact partition by default. If custom test_size or random_state parameters are submitted via POST /api/models/train, the service dynamically re-splits from 03_Clean_Data/bank-full_clean.csv to honor the requested experimental setup.
